'''Stun grenades''' were [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] opponents, usually used when the object of a mission was to detain, capture, or subdue rather than kill.

==Description==
[[File:StunGrenade.jpg|thumb|left|Stun grenade explosion]]
These weapons were small, weighed about 0.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], and had a blast radius of between 3 and 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] units, local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]], and military personnel were known to use them. These grenades were designed to explode on impact and could knock out individuals caught within the blast radius from the concussive force released. They were effective against organic, living targets, not [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or electronics; [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenades]] or similar devices would be used to incapacitate droids. From [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], these items typically cost 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but were sometimes available for as low as 250. As with other explosives, they were often restricted.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] weapons manufacturer produced a couple of variants of the stun grenade, including the [[C-10 stun grenade/Legends|C-10 stun grenade]], and the [[C-14A stun grenade/Legends|C-14A stun grenade]] which had the unusual ability to be recharged and reused. Another variant was the [[Spore/B stun grenade/Legends|Spore/B stun grenade]] which actually released microscopic [[Bothan stun spore]]s to incapacitate targets.

==History==
During the [[Rise of the Empire era]], stun grenades were carried by [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] they were used by [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]] and elite prison guards known as [[Imperial Dungeoneer]]s.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Rebellion era]] they were used by [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Spacetroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce infiltrators]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Stun grenades were used by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the Galactic Empire as well as Stormtroopers in the [[Empire of the Hand]].

Other users of stun grenades were [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who tracked and recovered sentient beings for a monetary reward. Since bounty hunters usually sought to capture their targets rather than kill them, stun grenades were a useful tool.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Law enforcement and security personnel also found stun grenades useful when non-lethal tactics were required.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
